known_photo_rejection.description: Fraction of ALL known_holdout images rejected (max_sim < threshold), correct and incorrect predictions alike.

threshold_provenance_note: This evaluation (the original, one-pass unknown_test_v1 run) used the frozen threshold value 0.60 as a hardcoded constant (FROZEN_THRESHOLD in eval_unknown_test.py at the time), not loaded from calibration_v1.json. eval_unknown_test.py was updated afterward to load and validate this same numeric value (0.60, operator 'max_sim < value') from calibration_v1.json's frozen_candidate_abstention_threshold.machine_readable_rule for future reproductions. The rule applied here is unchanged -- 0.60, max_sim < value -- and no part of this evaluation was rerun; only this note and calibration_v1.json's sha256 (in hashes, above) were added after the fact.
